summary: Positive Pay submission tracking (Ed 2026-10-22). Adds bank_accounts.positive_pay_enabled + positive_pay_start_date, enables the four NewFirst operating accounts on the Addendum (Canyon Gate 5313, Still Creek 1777, LOPF 2449, Waterview 5961) with NO start date (nothing exports until the backlog is reviewed), and creates positive_pay_submissions + positive_pay_submission_items with a one-live-submission-per-check unique index.
